title: Console layout refinements for interactive charts, tables, and modal behaviors
creator: Asha Patel
description: Polish and harden layout and interaction patterns across key console pages (Dashboards, Rollouts, Cost views). This ticket covers responsive breakpoints and cross-browser edge cases for interactive charts, virtualized tables, and modal dialogs. Goals: remove layout jank at intermediate widths, ensure charts tooltips and brushing work in Safari/Firefox/Chrome, stabilize modal stacking/scroll behavior, and maintain keyboard/accessibility behavior for tables and cost breakdown controls.
acceptance_criteria: Layout adapts smoothly between 320px and 1920px without overlapping header/filters or clipped charts
Chart interactions (hover tooltips, click-to-focus, legend toggles, brush/zoom) function in Chrome, Safari (macOS & iOS), and Firefox with consistent pointer events
Virtualized tables keep row heights stable during window resizes and support keyboard navigation (arrow keys, page up/down, home/end) and screen reader announcements
Modal stack rules: new modals open above existing overlays, background scroll is locked without layout shift, and focus trap works for nested modals
Cost breakdown component retains token/price alignment across zoom levels and DPI settings and passes visual diff baseline on staging
All changed components have unit/story tests and a minimal cross-browser test matrix documented
tasks: Audit current console pages for breakpoints where elements overlap (dashboards, rollouts, cost view)
Prototype alternate layout for charts + sidebar filters (Figma responsive components)
Implement CSS fixes: container queries where appropriate, safe-area handling, scrollbar/gutter accounting
Switch chart render fallback from SVG to canvas for large-series slow paths and test pointer/touch mapping
Adjust table virtualization margin strategy to avoid cut-off decimals in cost columns
Create focused cross-browser QA checklist and run on macOS Chrome, Safari (desktop + iOS), Firefox, and Windows Chrome
Ship minor visual fixes behind feature flag and coordinate with engineering for rollout gating
review_notes: PM (Liam O'Connor) asked to prioritize cost view token alignment at small widths
Eng (Noah Kim) flagged Safari pointer capture differences for canvas fallback; recommended pointer-event mapping shim
Accessibility review (Jesse Rivera) requested explicit aria-live regions for table pagination updates
Design review: prefer container-query approach over multiple hard breakpoints to reduce maintenance
UX suggested reducing modal max-width and adding stacked header breadcrumb for nested context
